name: @spectra/console
description: SPECTRA certificate viewer. Plain ES modules, no build step, no dependency.

scripts.build: echo 'spectra: there is no build. The page loads ./src/app.js as a module by relative path; a bundler would add a step nothing here needs.' 1>&2; exit 1

spectra.status: the viewer renders a certificate; the prove flow of M8 is not started
spectra.why_no_dependencies: This machine is offline and no package may be installed, so a dependency would be a file nobody can fetch and a lockfile nobody can honour. TypeScript was removed for the same reason: a .ts file that nothing can compile is a file that lies about being built. The suites run on the runtime the repository already has.
spectra.invariant: The viewer computes no verdict, no count and no digest. Every figure it shows is read from a file that was already emitted, and a page that recomputed one would be a second implementation nobody checks (Part II 75.2 C10).
